say:1:1711059001:1.text: Gervan, I should've mentioned earlier. Due to the current workload, Silven's been assigned to assist Cassadee as an apprentice mage.
say:1:1711059001:1.source_cn: 格墨文，忘了提前告诉你，鉴于魔法事务司目前积压的工作量...

say:2:1711059002:1.text: And since you've been cooperative, I'll give you a few minutes to catch up with your old classmate.
say:2:1711059002:1.source_cn: 特事特办，看在你配合我们的份上，我可以给你几分钟时间，...

say:3:1711059003:1.text: No need. I have nothing to say to a "champion of justice".
say:3:1711059003:1.source_cn: 不必了。我和“正义的伙伴”没什么可聊的。

say:5:1711059004:1.text: ... After all this time, that's how you treat a friend?
say:5:1711059004:1.source_cn: ……这么久不见，这就是你对朋友的态度？

say:6:1711059005:1.text: Oh? And what were you expecting?
say:6:1711059005:1.source_cn: 哦……？那你期待我拿出什么样的态度呢？

say:7:1711059006:1.text: Should I act pitiful, so you can indulge your sense of heroism? Will you offer me your sympathy?
say:7:1711059006:1.source_cn: 让我猜猜，难道是希望我表现得可怜一点？好激起你心底那泛...

say:8:1711059007:1.text: Stop saying that crap! I-I've been worried about you!
say:8:1711059007:1.source_cn: 少说这些混账话！我、我一直在担心你！

say:9:1711059008:1.source_cn: 省省吧，不要浪费你那廉价的感情了。

say:10:1711059009:1.text: In the end, a criminal like me and a noble family's knight like you were never truly friends.
say:10:1711059009:1.source_cn: 说到底，罪人格墨文和骑士家族的休，根本算不上是朋友。

say:12:1711059010:1.text: Don't say that... Silven has always considered you a friend!
say:12:1711059010:1.source_cn: 你别这样说，格墨文……休一直把你当朋友！

say:15:1711059012:1.text:
Liar!
You've never told the truth, not back then, and not now!
say:15:1711059012:1.source_cn: 撒谎！\n你嘴里没有一句真话，过去没有，现在也没有！

say:16:1711059013:1.text: You fooled me once. I believed you didn't care about the rumors, that you could face everything calmly...
say:16:1711059013:1.source_cn: 我被你骗过，相信你真的不在乎家族里的流言蜚语，相信你真...

say:17:1711059014:1.text: But I won't be fooled again! Gervan, you coward!
say:17:1711059014:1.source_cn: 但如今，我不会再被你骗第二次！格墨文，你这个懦夫！
